column1: # The named aesthetics of the author's corpus, and what a theme has to show to
# claim one. A claim is not a label: a theme that says it is Verdigrís
# Nocturno has to actually carry the hexes the doctrine fixes for it, and
# The last column is whether the aesthetic tolerates ornament at all. El Ancla
# does not: the doctrine calls it anti-ornamento, functional neutrals and Deep
# Winter contrast, and an aesthetic that refuses decoration keeps refusing it
